chapter: Kansas City, Basie, Prez and Booker Pittman
title: Jap Allen's band and Clyde Hart's arrangements
summary: Ben joins Jap Allen's band, with Clyde Hart writing arrangements amid McKinney's Cotton Pickers' fame.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: That's right, and his aunt's and all, and you know, like when I -- Ben finally came back to Kansas city and joined a band called Jap Allen. And Clyde Hart was
writing the arrangements. Now Clyde Hart -- at that time McKinney's Cotton Pickers was very, very, very famous.
That's out in the west, out here in the east.
That's right, they were from Detroit. When they were traveling around they were known as the greatest dance band in the business.
Well, they had Prince Robinson with them, and all.
